svg.title: Copenhagen meet Green SM — content upgrade proof v02
svg.desc: A0 landscape marketing-plan poster, D-159 content-upgrade proof v02. Label-level edits inside the ten existing cells; identity cloud uses Dr and one global proposal statement; References are on the back of the chart; no member-contribution strip (lecturer guidance LG-005), so the approved background shows below the car. Lettering reuses the approved glyph outlines. Awaits student review.
